title: Moody Ghasts
description: A resource pack that adds a bunch of new possible emotions for the Happy Ghast!
body:
![Title of resource pack, Moody Ghasts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a40d46c6622cd4b60ed86f6e7cf287cefcbd65f.png)
**Intro:**

Are you happy with the Happy Ghasts? Have you ever wondered if you could be happier? What about having other feelings towards them? Because they certainly have other feelings now!

**Features:**

This resource pack (which only requires a few mods to work) adds _16 new emotions_ for the Happy Ghasts which will randomly be selected for each Happy Ghast.

Grab your Ghastling, feed it well, and rejoice as it grows up into a _Gleeful_, _Silly_, or _Cute Ghasts_! Unless, of course, it grows into an _Angry_, _Sick_, or _Tired Ghast_. Then again, maybe you want that... all in all there's lots of emotion going around!

_Have any suggestions for more emotions? Tell me on BlueSky! (Or just follow me there if you want to see updates to the pack)_ https://bsky.app/profile/mypowerbob.bsky.social


**Installation:**

There are two options for installing this pack and getting it to work.

_Option 1: Optifine._

The easiest and fastest way is to install Optifine.

Download and install Optifine here: https://optifine.net/home

Download the Moody Ghasts pack and place it in your Resourcepack folder.

_Option 2: Non-Optifine._

If you're like me you're using some alternatives to Optifine instead. In that case there are some other mods you can install.

Download and install Fabric: https://fabricmc.net/
OR download and install Forge: https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/

Download Entity Texture Features and place it in the Mods folder:  https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures

Download the Moody Ghasts pack and place it in your Resourcepack folder.
